shared_elements: anthropomorphic body with a bird's head
relief-carved figures on a flat vertical field
justification: The one notable correspondence is that both surfaces carry a bird-headed humanoid figure shown in profile, together with circular motifs (rosettes on A, rings on B), which is more specific than mere generic figuration. Otherwise the content diverges sharply: A shows a single large winged, robed genius holding a bucket and cone between elaborate flowering plants under a dense band of script, rendered with detailed naturalistic musculature and feathering, while B shows tiny, extremely schematic paired symbols and profile heads spread over the curved back of a monumental human head-and-torso form with no wings, plants, handled objects or inscription.
